summary: Frontend-only testing of IBGE 2026 enrollment form UF→Municipality selector feature. Verified both new fieldsets on /dados-inscricao.html: (1) 'Local de Prova' with UF_PROVA and MUNICIPIO_PROVA dropdowns, (2) 'Área de Trabalho' with UF_TRABALHO and MUNICIPIO_TRABALHO dropdowns. All tests passed: dropdowns exist with correct data-testid attributes, UF has 28 options (27 states + placeholder), selecting a state loads municipalities from local JSON, both pairs work independently, changing UF resets municipality dropdown, and auto-selection of Certame/Escolaridade/Cargo still works.
critical_code_review_comments: uf-municipios.js correctly implements UF→Municipality binding using local JSON data (municipios-br.json with 5,571 municipalities)
Both UF+Municipality pairs work independently - selecting RJ for Trabalho doesn't affect SP selection for Prova
data-testid attributes correctly set: select-uf-prova, select-municipio-prova, select-uf-trabalho, select-municipio-trabalho
Restore mechanism works with async retry for saved values from localStorage
context_for_next_testing_agent: UF→Municipality feature fully tested. The municipios-br.json file contains all 5,571 Brazilian municipalities grouped by state code. SP has 646 municipalities, RJ has 93. The uf-municipios.js file pre-loads data on page load for instant response.
